211-native-windows-file-policy.reason: Issue #211: Windows file access-policy snapshots and copies move from a PowerShell helper (whose 20-second bound timed out in CI staging transactions) into gitcraft-os, which owns the unsafe Win32 calls. gitcraft's standalone::windows_metadata needs exactly four items: PolicyError (to localize failures), file_policy_snapshot and copy_file_policy (production), and file_policy_snapshot_in_scope (comparison with the reviewed PowerShell reference in tests). The descriptor, stream and reparse-tag parsers stay crate-private.
211-native-windows-file-policy.remediation: Narrow the pre-existing unused os exports the checker lists (for example BUNDLE_*_BYTES, file_identity, retire_private_receipt), or fold file_policy_snapshot_in_scope into a test-support feature, then ratchet the budget.
